name: mothership-ram-wide
description: Ram the Mother-Ship in era 0, where the player-vs-Mother-Ship test hands over to the wide box, vs MAME.
_grounding: Kill quota held at 0 (0xAD02=0 from f620, 400 frames) so the game arms the Mother-Ship (f960). At f1060 its sprite entry is moved onto the player (MOTHER_SHIP_ENTRY 0xAA24=0x84, MOTHER_SHIP_SPRITE_Y 0xAA55=0x68); the game's own player/Mother-Ship contact check then finds the contact and writes 0xF0 into both PLAYER_STATE and MOTHER_SHIP_STATE (golden f1062, 'responded'). The player's death countdown ends during the Mother-Ship's transition hold, so loseLifeAndHandOver and startNextRound run together (golden ~f1242). Era 0 is in WIDE_WINDOW_ERAS, so the contact is destroyPlayerAndMotherShipOnContact (0x50EE).
